organization: PT Reasuransi Indonesia Utama (Persero) — Indonesia Re
identified_problem: As Indonesia’s national reinsurer, Indonesia Re covers general and life reinsurance for cedents across the archipelago, where recurrent Jakarta floods and dry-season peatland fires in Kalimantan and Sumatra drive insured property, motor and infrastructure losses.
climate_exposure: Its reinsurance book accumulates flood and wildfire risk from cedents operating in low-lying Greater Jakarta and fire-prone peatland regions.
potential_pain: Sudden spikes in flood and wildfire claims after major events strain reserve adequacy, treaty pricing and accumulation control.
evidence: Official homepage articles explicitly discuss flood disaster losses (e.g. ‘Bencana Banjir’) and the reinsurer’s underwriting focus, confirming exposure to Indonesia’s key hazards.
relevant_capability: Multi-hazard portfolio screening and historical event intelligence with source-attached results.
recommended_message: Show how Talaix can map cedents’ exposure to Jakarta flood and peatland-fire zones to support treaty pricing, accumulation control and claims preparedness.
fit_score: National reinsurer with a public focus on disaster risk; location-level flood/wildfire intelligence directly improves underwriting and risk selection.

interactions.summary: Identified via official-source research; signal: national reinsurer homepage discusses flood risk and underwriting categories.

next_action: Qualify: verify current public signal and select contact route
